Privacy Rabbit Hole Recap

Zcash on Aztec & The Future of Programmable Privacy

Hosts & Guests
@realRoberto38, @clairekart , @0xdavid 

Speakers:
@bajpaiharsh244 
@zmanian 
@Zac_Aztec 
@clairekart 

Lets Get started:
1⃣ Harsh’s Presentation “ZEC on Aztec”

• Context: Why Zcash

• Launched 2016, PoW chain, 21M cap like BTC.

• Privacy at the base layer, shielded transactions.

• Endorsed by Edward Snowden, Naval: “If Bitcoin is insurance against fiat, Zcash is insurance against Bitcoin’s publicity.”

• Zashi wallet: easy private payments; “encrypted burritos” joke during demo.

• Aztec Overview

• Aztec = Private World Computer, just like Ethereum was the “world computer” for Bitcoin’s base layer.

• Combines Zcash-style privacy + Ethereum programmability.

• Supports private smart contracts, partial privacy, public–private composability.
“You choose what parts of your program you want to keep private or public.”

2⃣ Zcash → Aztec Bridge Concept

• Problem: current Zashi + Near intents swaps leak metadata (sender/receiver visible).

• Aztec solution: “Partial Notes”, lets users receive funds without revealing their address.

- Alice → sends ZEC privately to a solver.
- Solver → sends USDC to Alice’s partial note on Aztec.
- Solver never learns Alice’s Zcash or Aztec address.
- No link between chains, full unlinkability.

• Future: Wrapped ZEC on Aztec

- Trustless bridge → mint wZEC on Aztec.

- Allows private DeFi for ZEC: lending, liquidity, yield.

- Can be secured via EigenLayer AVS or fully-ZK light clients.
“ZEC holders could earn yield privately while maintaining full censorship resistance.”

• Demo Summary

• Live Zcash testnet swap → Aztec local node.

• Initial solver lacked balance → fixed mid-demo.

• Successful private swap confirmed (“Congratulations, your private swap is successful”).

• Applause from chat: “3,600 people watching privacy in action!”

3⃣ Fireside Chat — Zaki Manian × Zach × Claire

Origins of Privacy

• Zaki:

- Privacy = essential to censorship resistance.

- Bitcoin lacks privacy → risk of “good vs. bad BTC.”

- Early 2010s talk with Aaron (ZeroCash) → “This is magic.”

- Zashi wallet = 2% → 20–30% shielded usage.

- Near intents + cross-chain swaps = “finally real privacy for real users.”

• Zach:

- Started in 2017 building DeFi (CreditsMint) → realized no privacy = no real finance.

- Bitcoin’s “pseudonymity” was illusion.

- Studied Zcash papers, became a self-taught cryptographer.
“Back then, understanding ZK was hell — now you can learn in a weekend.”

• why Optional Privacy

• Zaki:

- Practical + compliance reasons: exchanges need transparent TX support.

- Gemini = only exchange supporting shielded deposits.

- Binance required a unique “transparent-only” address type to stay listed.

• Zach:

• For Aztec, optional privacy is programmability & trust trade-off:
- Private users shouldn’t inadvertently help bad actors hide.

- Hybrid models allow transparent protocols + private users.

- Fully private DEXes need advanced MPC/FHE tech — not production-ready yet.

• Cross-Chain & Future of Privacy

• Zaki:

- “2025–2026 is the first time the rubber meets the road for private systems.”

- Two privacy paths:
a) Encrypted balances (limited, enterprise use).

b) Full private layers (like Aztec & Zcash).

- Zcash aims to remain a private store-of-value, Aztec provides programmable privacy.

• Claire: Why is privacy booming now?

• Zach:

- “Blockchain’s protest phase is over. Now it’s institutional, and institutions need privacy.”

- “Either they fork chains privately or they adopt privacy-preserving layers like Aztec.”

• Zaki:

- “Privacy matters most to whales & institutions — those with real capital to protect.”

- “If you’re running a DeFi protocol, you can’t reveal every trade on-chain. Privacy becomes business-critical.”

4⃣ Community Activation

• Zaki announced a Zashi onboarding event:

- Roles eligible: Illuminated and Paragon.
- Participants install Zashi → receive small ZEC drop directly from him.
“A surprise mini-airdrop, real ZEC for real privacy users.”

• Rebranding: Town Hall → Privacy Rabbit Hole

• Claire:

“Aztec believes Privacy must win. Not just Aztec, the entire movement.”

- Town Hall renamed to “Privacy Rabbit Hole” → open forum for all privacy builders (ECC, EF, Monero, etc.).

- Future guests will include Ethereum Foundation privacy leads and other ecosystems.

5⃣ Community Awards (Discord Names)
• Meme Lord

- HellforNDR → recurring meme favorite (“No airdrop, still love you”).

• Maestros

- Web3 Genio → IRL Aztec flyers, stickers, meetups — “Privacy is the future.”

- Caperson (Sui Swap) → short-form news-style Aztec explainer videos.

- Ayana (Philippines) → Honk Skater Boy art.

- Yelena → surreal Honk x tentacle digital art timelapse.

• Content Chronicler

- NotBored (Opay Me DeFi) → regular video explainers tagged.

• Operator Roles

- Proposer Commander: Boss7140

- High Attester: AgeSaints

- Homestaker Sentinel: Pavel M0542

6⃣ Final Stats & Announcements

• Snapshot recorded: 4,662 attendees.

• IRL Meetups: Continuing in Philippines, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Nigeria, Argentina.

• Zashi onboarding: live in Paragon & Illuminated channels.

Next Privacy Rabbit Hole: Ethereum Foundation guest + Aztec ecosystem collabs.
